name: smwmusic-mega-man-4-sky-of-danger-dr-cossack-s-citadel-3
title: Mega Man 4 - Sky of Danger ~ Dr. Cossack's Citadel 3 & 4 (Remix)
description:
𝗬𝗼𝘂 𝗯𝗲𝘁𝗿𝗮𝘆𝗲𝗱 𝗺𝗲, 𝗣𝗿𝗼𝘁𝗼 𝗠𝗮𝗻! 𝗜'𝗺 𝗴𝗼𝗻𝗻𝗮 𝗯𝗿𝗲𝗮𝗸 𝘆𝗼𝘂, 𝗠𝗲𝗴𝗮 𝗠𝗮𝗻!!

Did a remix of Dr. Cossack's Citadel 3 & 4 from Mega Man 4. Had loads of fun doing this one, and it is one of the most memorable themes in the series. It's also incredibly catchy as well!! Got the idea of doing this song after hearing (again) an old port of this song used as the final stage theme in Super Mario World: The After Years (Ultra).

This song is great for towers, cities, castle, castle ground, factory, and even underwater temple stages.

Important:
There is a "!READ ME.txt" file that has the sample bank. You'll need to move what's in that file into "Addmusic_sample_groups.txt."
- @7 & Thunder SFX is disabled.
